title: About Bedside Glass Pressure Rupture
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 310 recent saved-signal files and 265 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @liamsLCjourney: Yesterday, I stepped down as CEO of my company. Not because I wanted to, but... and The Severe PEM Crash Survival Guide, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Bedside Glass Pressure Rupture: Bedside glass pressure rupture: a product-photo rupture in shallow macro, one huge right-weighted tilted pale oval slab crossed by oversized transparent lens arcs, a black triangular wedge surging from lower left, a pale pillow crescent compressed at lower right, and a hard vertical light slit at far left. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against dominant pale face slab with skin grain, soft lower-right pillow crescent and torn seam, and clear eyeglass rim orbit around closed eye.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
